sed -i 's/simpa \[pow_two\] using hA2.integrable_mul hA2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, pow_two] using hA2.integrable_mul hA2/; s/simpa \[pow_two\] using hB2.integrable_mul hB2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, pow_two] using hB2.integrable_mul hB2/; s/simpa \[pow_two\] using hC2.integrable_mul hC2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, pow_two] using hC2.integrable_mul hC2/; s/simpa using hA2.integrable_mul hB2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply] using hA2.integrable_mul hB2/; s/simpa using hA2.integrable_mul hC2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply] using hA2.integrable_mul hC2/; s/simpa using hB2.integrable_mul hC2/simpa only [Pi.mul_apply] using hB2.integrable_mul hC2/' /tmp/Check.lean

cd /work/ProbabilityTheoryFormalization && /opt/lean/bin/lake env lean /tmp/Check.lean
